The '''City Bigspace''' was a popular concourse in the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] city of [[Otoh Gunga/Legends|Otoh Gunga]], located in the depths of [[Lake Paonga/Legends|Lake Paonga]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].

==Description==
The City Bigspace was commissioned by [[Boss/Legends|Boss]] [[Rugor Nass/Legends|Rugor Nass]], eager to leave his mark on the development of the lake city. It became a popular attraction for visitors from all over Otoh Gunga and the surrounding Gungan settlements. A multi-level entertainment district, there were several boutiques, theaters, and performance venues. The walkways were dotted with local art, fountains, and gardens waiting to be explored by visitors. The notable [[City Bigspace Refreshment Bubble|Refreshment Bubble]] provided a wide variety of restaurants and refreshment vendors.
